what_this_is: Reconciliation across the 12 deterministic shards of the exact admissible-control construction. A_exact = A_interior UNION A_supplement, where A_supplement recovers every admissible start that the affine-interior argument could not prove safe (chain-block boundaries, gaps, inverted/minus-strand blocks).

band_reconciliation.note: uncovered must be exactly 0: every band position is either proven affine-safe or explicitly enumerated as a supplement candidate. A nonzero value would mean the construction silently dropped part of the search space.

payload_integrity_reverified_at_commit_t.what_the_receipt_field_payload_sha256_ac: the SHA-256 of json.dumps(payload, sort_keys=True).encode() -- the canonical uncompressed JSON serialization -- NOT the bytes of the .json.gz file on disk (builder lines 408-411).
payload_integrity_reverified_at_commit_t.why_this_matters: A verifier running sha256sum on the committed shard_NN.json.gz gets a value that does not equal the receipt's payload_sha256 and would reasonably conclude the artifact was corrupted or substituted. It was not. The content hash is the stronger of the two (immune to gzip mtime and compression-level variation) but the field name did not say so.

interpretation.evidence: 177,442 admissible starts exist that the affine-interior argument alone could not certify. A sampler restricted to A_interior would have been unable to ever draw them.
interpretation.what_this_does_NOT_yet_establish: That the sampler drawing from A_exact is uniform and correctly fails closed. That is the frozen qualification suite, which has not run.
